'''Mol Beldun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Brought into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] early in his life, Beldun was trained at the experimental [[Almas Academy]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] as opposed to the [[Jedi academy|academy]] within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After training one-on-one with a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and passing his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], Beldun was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|elevated]] to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="AUP" />

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Beldun was sent to the [[Jedi enclave (Cularin)|Jedi enclave]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] by the [[Almas Academy]]. Ordered to represent the Almas Academy during the celebrations for Cularin's 200th anniversary since it was colonized, Beldun was to ensure that the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] in attendance were acting appropriately and where they needed to be. He also spoke to several Masters, directing them towards [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] in need of a master.<ref name="AUP" />
